🤰 MI SB 0415 — Michigan Expands Coverage for Group Prenatal Care

Starting immediately, the Michigan Department of Health and Human Services will cover group prenatal care services for eligible individuals through the medical assistance program.

July 3, 2026: Roll Call: Roll Call # 217 Yeas 36 Nays 0 Excused 2 Not Voting 0.
